title: Skip the Line Chicago Art Institute Tour Semi-Private 12ppl Max
includes: Semi-Private Means Group Size Is Never More Than 8 Guests Maximum
Tour price does NOT include gratuities (optional)
Tour price does NOT include hotel pickup or drop-off (we recommend UBER or Taxi)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
A maximum of 12 people per booking
This tour will not run without a minimum of 2 guests to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund.
policies: Notes: The museum may be subjected to occasional closures without previous warning from the museum management. When this occurs, we will provide guests with an appropriate alternative if the museum opening time is delayed more than 1h from the tour starting time. In these cases we are unable to provide refunds or discounts. Appropriate dress is required for entry into some sites on this tour. No large bags or suitcases are allowed inside the museum, only handbags or small thin bag packs are allowed through security. Due to increased security measures at many attractions some lines may form on tours with 'Skip the Line' or 'No Wait' access. Some specific rooms inside the museum are subjected to a very quiet or restricted right to speak inside, in this cases your guide will provide the information about this places before entering the specific rooms where this rule applies. Some collections may vary along the year.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Art Institute of Chicago attracts nearly as many visitors as other leading galleries like the Met, Louvre & British Museum. On this 2.5 hour semi-private (12 Guest Maximum) guided museum tour, you’ll be able to skip the line and explore it’s most famous pieces with the help of an engaging guide who will lead the way.
